items.title: 8.16.1 Haber process se ammonia ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.1, printed pages 183-184.

blocks.text: Nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia ka banna reversible hai: N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g), delta H = -92.2 kJ (yani fi mole NH3 -46.11 kJ). Zyada se zyada yield teen tareeqon se milti hai: waqtan fawaqtan ammonia ko bartan se hata kar us ki concentration ghatayein, taake Le Chatelier ke usool se equilibrium aage shift ho; zyada dabao istemal karein, kyunke reactants ke chaar moles product ke do moles dete hain aur reaction ghat-te hajm ke saath chalti hai, to zyada dabao equilibrium ko daen shift karta hai; aur darja hararat ghatayein, kyunke reaction exothermic hai aur thanda karna use aage shift karta hai. Table 8.1 aur yield graph dikhate hain ke yield par dabao aur darja hararat ka asar bohat numayan hai: sab se mukammal tabdeeli 473 K (200 degrees C) aur 1000 atm par 98.3 feesad hai. 200 degrees C par yield ko tarjeeh milti hai magar rate bohat sust aur amal ghair-iqtisadi ho jata hai, to darja hararat darmiyane 400 degrees C tak barhaya aur rate barhane ke liye catalyst istemal kiya jata hai; catalyst ke baghair wahi rate kahin zyada darja hararat mangti, jo yield ghatata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3 ke saath delta H = -46.11 kJ mol-1 likha hai. -46.11 kJ ek mole NH3 banne ki enthalpy hai; muadle mein 2NH3 bante hain, is liye is muadle ke liye delta H = 2 x (-46.11) = -92.2 kJ hai. Kitab khud Sample 6.13 mein isi muadle ke liye -91.8 kJ nikalti hai. Nishan manfi hi hai, reaction exothermic hai, aur baqi nateeje wahi rehte hain.

blocks.alt: NH3 ki yield (%) 0 se 100 tak, darja hararat 200 se 700 °C ke muqable. Paanch girte curves: 1000 atm, 600 atm, 300 atm, 100 atm aur 10 atm. 200 °C par yield taqreeban 98, 95, 90, 81 aur 50 feesad; darja hararat barhne par sab girti hain. Taqreeban 400 °C aur 43 feesad par 100 atm aur 300 atm curves ke darmiyan ek chhota daira hai jis se teer 'Industrial conditions' ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4: Paanch mukhtalif dabaon par darja hararat (°C) ke muqable ammonia ki feesad yield (kitab ki Figure 8.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har curve ek dabao ka hai: dabao jitna zyada, curve utna oopar, yani yield zyada. Har curve daen taraf girta hai kyunke reaction exothermic hai aur garmi yield ghatati hai. Daira sanati halaat dikhata hai: 200 se 300 atm aur taqreeban 400 °C, jahan yield kam (taqreeban 40 feesad) magar reaction kaafi tez hai.

blocks.caption: Ammonia synthesis ke Kc par darja hararat ka asar (Table 8.1)

items: Darja hararat taqreeban 673 K (400 degrees C).
Catalyst: MgO, Al2O3 aur SiO2 ke pighle mixture mein lohe ke crystals ke tukre.

blocks.prompt: Darja hararat barhne par N2, H2, NH3 system mein ammonia ka tanasub kaise badalta hai, delta H ka nishan kya hai, aur darja hararat barhane par Kp ko kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Darja hararat barhne par ammonia ka tanasub girta hai, jaise Table 8.1 ki girti Kc qeematein aur yield curves dikhate hain. Delta H manfi hai (-92.2 kJ is muadle ke liye, yani -46.11 kJ fi mol NH3), reaction exothermic hai. Le Chatelier ke usool se darja hararat barhana reverse, endothermic simt ko tarjeeh deta hai, to Kp, Kc ki tarah, ghatta hai.

items: N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3, exothermic, gas ke 4 moles se 2: yield dabao, ammonia hatane aur kam darja hararat se barhti hai (200 degrees C aur 1000 atm par 98.3 feesad), magar kam darja hararat bohat sust hai.
Behtareen: 200 se 300 atm, taqreeban 673 K, pighle MgO, Al2O3 aur SiO2 mein loha catalyst; Kc 200 K par 7.15 x 10^15 se 800 K par 3.96 x 10^-2 tak girta hai.
